options.label: Show navigation in HUD/gauge cluster
options.description: The next turn, its distance and the road name in the instrument cluster and the HUD. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Show directions
options.description: When the next turn shows in the cluster and the HUD. At any distance is the iDrive checkbox Show directions at any distance. Set here, it wins over that checkbox.

options.label: Disable logging (performance test)
options.description: Silences every log, so a run leaves no log to read. For a performance test only. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Prompts on car radio (BT, beta)
options.description: Bluetooth audio only: navigation prompts play on the car's own prompter, so the radio ducks. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Android Auto over USB (beta)
options.description: Android Auto over the car's USB port. While it is on, wireless Android Auto is not offered at all. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Use Phone GPS
options.description: For cars without the navigation antenna: the phone uses its own GPS, compass and motion sensors. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Use WiFi Direct Network
options.description: The Wi-Fi network the phone is offered. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Use Native Audio instead of Bluetooth
options.description: How Android Auto's sound reaches the car. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: Media Controls for LCI Steering Wheels
options.description: The steering wheel's previous and next keys work Android Auto's media, in native audio. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.

options.label: CarPlay compatibility
options.description: For cars that use the factory CarPlay as well as Android Auto. Set here, it wins over the checkbox on iDrive.
